pick.headline: Iraq invades Iran
pick.fbis: The Middle East and South Asia review of September 23, 1980, reported that on September 22 Iraq launched air raids on at least 10 Iranian bases, citing Baghdad radio, and that Iraqi forces were advancing toward "vital positions inside Iran."
